description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Delegation of Powers by the Public Service Commission in terms of Article 57(1) of the Constitution
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically deals with the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission regarding transfers and administrative procedures for various categories of education sector officers. It focuses on public service administration, recruitment procedures, and delegation of authority within the public sector, which aligns perfectly with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) that covers public service recruitment, service conditions, and administrative circulars.
